mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DUTY_REQUEST (REQ_ID, LOGIN_ID, USER_NAME, DEPT_NAME, KIND, START_DATE, END_DATE, HALF_DAY, START_TIME, END_TIME, DAYS, HOURS, DESTINATION, REASON, DOC_ID, CREATED_AT, TRIP_AREA, TRIP_HOURS, OFFICIAL_CAR, LODGING_NIGHTS, LODGING_REGION, EST_AMOUNT) VALUES (#{reqId}, #{loginId}, #{userName}, #{deptName}, #{kind}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{halfDay}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{days, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{hours, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{destination}, #{reason}, #{docId}, #{createdAt}, #{tripArea, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripHours, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{officialCar, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{lodgingNights, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lodgingRegion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{estAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DUTY_REQUEST R JOIN APPROVAL_DOC D ON D.DOC_ID = R.DOC_ID WHERE R.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND D.STATUS IN ('PROG', 'DONE') AND D.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND R.START_DATE <= #{to, jdbcType=DATE} AND R.END_DATE >= #{from, jdbcType=DATE} AND R.KIND = 'OVERTIME' AND R.KIND <> 'OVERTIME'
